sentences.text: Heard Mr. S. Munir, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. D. B.
Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
This is an application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner, who are apprehending arrest in connection with All Women P.S. Case No.
06/2025, under Sections 109/325/406/495/498A of the Indian Penal Code.

It is submitted by Mr. Munir, learned counsel for the petitioner, that the present accused/petitioners are innocent and they are no way connected in the alleged offence and the only allegation brought against the present petitioners is that they also assaulted the victim.
All the petitioners are residing separately from F.I.R. named accused No. 1 and they are not at all involved in the alleged offence.
However, they are ready and willing to co-operate the I.O. in the further investigation of this case if they are granted with the privilege of pre- arrest bail.

In this context, Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, has submitted that the Case Diary will reveal the actual fact of the case and accordingly insisted on calling for the Case Diary before passing any order on Page No.# 3/4 pre-arrest bail.
After hearing the submissions of learned counsels for both sides, it is provided that the Case Diary be called for fixing 09.05.2025.

Further, considering the submissions of learned counsels for both sides and also considering the other aspects of the case, I find it a fit case to extend the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioners till receipt of the Case Diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the accused/petitioners, namely, (i) Smti.
Rekha Sinha, (ii) Smti Reela Sinha & (iii) Smti. Niyoti Rajkumar

, in connection with All Women P.S.
Case No. 06/2025, under Sections 109/325/406/ 495/498A of the Indian Penal Code, they shall be enlarged on interim pre-arrest bail on their executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) only each with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority,
subject to the following conditions:
(i) that the petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of 1 (one) week from today to enable recording of their statements;
(ii) that the petitioners shall fully co-operate with the investigation of the case and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and Page No.# 4/4 when required in connection with the investigation of the aforesaid P.S. Case; and (iii) that the petitioners shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
